subject: Too early too tell for me
author: Beep
body: I haven't yet had the time to investigate the 88 special as a stunt run car or the manhattan for stunt runs as i have been busy, although i did get online yesturday and had fun in the bootlegger, but for stunt runs till i get time to try the 88 special the hawker solo is still my stunt run car and looking forward to the mech, maybe the 88 special will change my mind and i will like that better but i think that its not gona be the best stunt run car for me as i will be constently hitting the hover mode.  🥵

subject: Great explanation
author: jwillisjr
body:
Seriously, that is a good explanation. Very good points. I guess for me, I don't mind how slow the P12 is.

 

"The sleep of reason produces monsters" -Goya

subject: In between
author: Mad Wookiee11
body: I used to drive either the P12 or the Carbon X12 in stunt runs if I wanted to use my best stunt cars (occasionally I use the Van in stunt runs), but the X12 is a bit too out-of-control and the P12 is a bit too slow IMO.  With the 88 special, it is nearly as fast as the X12, but much more stable.  Plus the flight mode makes it easier to get barrel rolls on the South Bay expressway bridge.

subject: Really?
author: jwillisjr
body:
I'm interested in hearing why. I can see if you were someone that drove stronger stunt cars than the P12 before the 88 came out, then went to the 88.  But going from the p12 to the 88 and not mentioning the difference in weight and such? Hmm...please help me understand as you can see, I am a firm believer in the P12's under-rated potential. I still have much to learn about the new Legendary cars.

 

"The sleep of reason produces monsters" -Goya

subject: I believe I can fly
author: Mad Wookiee11
body: Personally, I think the 88 special is my best stunt car, though I usually tend to stick with ground mode during stunt runs.  That thing gets wicked air!
